name: Facts list
summary: Label and value pairs, such as “Your handle” and “Your sign-in code”. Handles and codes read correctly in any language.

when: To show a few facts someone needs, such as in the recovery email.

anatomy.description: The fact. Handles get an @; codes are grouped.

props.name: facts
props.items: label, value, and kind: text, handle or code

states.name: Handle
states.description: With an @, isolated so it reads correctly in Arabic.

states.name: Code
states.description: Grouped, monospace, and read digit by digit.

accessibility.name: None.
screenReader: Each label is read with its value.
Codes are read digit by digit.

guidelines: Labels are short: “Your handle”, “Your sign-in code”.

dosAndDonts.do: Keep it to a few facts.

evidence.point: Handles and codes are isolated so they don't reorder inside right-to-left text (#6).
